channel.title: Bogan Elementary School News
channel.description: News and announcements from Bogan Elementary School, including events, activities, and important dates.

item.title: Summer Scoops Literacy Camp at Oxford Lane Library
item.description:
Summer Scoops Literacy Camp is offered for incoming 1st-3rd graders on July 14-16 from 10:00 AM-12:00 PM at Oxford Lane Library (441 S. Locust St., Oxford, OH 45056). The camp provides individualized support to nurture reading skills and confidence. Parents can use the QR code to sign up their child for the program.

item.title: End of Year Message from Counselor
item.description:
The school counselor reflects on a successful school year and wishes students and families a restful summer. School will resume in August. The counselor expresses appreciation for watching students grow and succeed throughout the year.

item.title: End of Year Message from Dr. Cannon
item.description:
Dr. Cannon reflects on a successful final week filled with celebrations and end-of-year activities. Students showed tremendous growth throughout the year, and the school community came together to support their achievements. Congratulations to 5th graders and the Talawanda Class of 2026! Dr. Cannon will return in the fall as Dr. Soros after getting married.

item.title: Older Americans Month Community Bingo
item.description:
Celebrate Older Americans Month in May by playing Community BINGO! Pick up a card at Oxford Seniors (922 Tollgate Dr.), Oxford Lane Library (441 S. Locust St.), The Knolls of Oxford, or Scripps Gerontology Center (396 Upham Hall). Complete activities like attending chair yoga, visiting parks, making art, attending concerts, and connecting with neighbors. Bring your completed card to the Intergenerational BINGO Party on May 31, 3:00-5:00 PM at Oxford Seniors for prizes and snacks.

item.title: Bogan Elementary Field Day Volunteer Opportunity
item.description:
Bogan Elementary is hosting Field Day on Friday, May 15th with two sessions: K-2 from 9:00-11:00 AM and grades 3-5 from 12:00-2:00 PM. Students need to bring a water bottle with name, tennis shoes (no Crocs or sandals), hat, and sunglasses. Volunteers are needed to help make the event successful - scan the QR code to sign up. item.title: Oxford Parks Master Plan Survey
item.description:
The City of Oxford is developing a Parks Master Plan with Pros Consulting and wants feedback from Talawanda families who use the parks. The survey includes virtual mapping and a vision board to help shape the future of Oxford's parks. Take the survey at: https://engagepros.mysocialpinpoint.com/oxford

Contact the City of Oxford at 513-523-6314 or visit cityofoxford.org for more information.

item.title: Camp Lane Summer Reading Program
item.description:
Camp Lane Summer Reading runs June 1 - August 1 at The Lane Libraries for all ages. Earn prizes by reading, attending library programs, and completing activities. Sign up at lanepl.beanstack.org to log points or ask a librarian. Locations include Hamilton, Fairfield, Oxford, Tech Center, and Bookmobile. Not affiliated with Talawanda School District. Friends of the Lane Libraries are supplying prizes.

item.title: May Cafeteria Menus and Lunch Accounts
item.description:
May breakfast and lunch menus are now available. Parents can add funds to student lunch accounts through PaySchool Central and should keep accounts current. For assistance with lunch debt, contact Mrs. White. The May breakfast menu includes items like Sausage & Cheese Biscuit Sandwiches, Mini Chocolate Donuts, Fresh Baked Cinnamon Rolls, Breakfast Pizza (Turkey Sausage), Apple Frudel, Stuffed Hash Brown, and Glazed Donuts, with 100% fruit juice, apples, oranges or other fresh fruit included with every breakfast. School is out for summer starting May 22nd.

item.description:

item.title: Lions Club Spring Eyeglass Collection Drive
item.description:
The Oxford Lions Club is collecting used eyeglasses, sunglasses, and cases to donate to children in need worldwide. The club modifies donated lenses and frames to meet individual children's eye needs and sends 900+ pairs annually. Donations are due by mid-May and can be sent to Betsy Beaton at Marshall Elementary School or Shaunna Tafelski at the Board Office, with pickup available upon request.

item.title: Weekly Update on Concerts and Testing
item.description:
Third graders performed in a concert on Wednesday evening, and fourth graders attended Ag Day at the high school to learn about the agriculture program. Students in grades 3-5 continue working on Ohio State Tests, with the final week of state testing scheduled for next week (3rd and 4th graders taking math tests, 5th graders taking science tests). Kindergarten through 3rd grade students will take spring MAP tests in the coming weeks.

item.title: Every Kid Healthy Week Activities
item.description:
Action for Healthy Kids presents Every Kid Healthy Week from April 20th-24th with daily themed activities: - Mindfulness Monday (April 20): Journaling, deep breathing, and sharing gratitude - Tasty Tuesday (April 21): Try new foods, help prepare meals, have an indoor picnic - Wellness Wednesday (April 22): Go for a walk, play outdoor games, have a dance party - Tech-Free Thursday (April 23): Device-free meals, turn off electronics for 1 hour for reading/arts/games - Family Friday (April 24): Pick a family activity and share appreciation for each family member

Families are encouraged to take pictures participating in activities and post on social media with #HealthyLikeRox.
